newsitem.title: USA: Investor group has Cairn merger concerns.
newsitem.headline: Investor group has Cairn merger concerns.

text.p: An investor group with a 7.4 percent stake in Cairn Energy USA Inc voiced concern in a regulatory filing Thursday about the company's proposed merger with Meridian Resource Corp.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group including Centennial Energy Partners said it has held talks with the company and intends to hold talks with other large shareholders. The group holds a 7.44 percent stake, or 1,307,600 shares, in Cairn.
It maintained that the terms of the merger "would result in a consideration to the company's shareholders substantially below the intrinsic value of the company's assets."
The group said in the filing that it has "not at this time" determined whether it will oppose the merger.
